text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...There exist various Triple Crowns in 
the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Above all, the title of 'Classic Triple 
Crown'—a challenge that can only be 
attempted once in a lifetime. What drives 
these Umamusume to pursue that path—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
First, the general consensus is that a 
Triple Crown Umamusume can truly be called 
an icon of her era.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown route is a 
proving ground with limited time. As such, 
it demands not only hard work, but also a 
measure of luck.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fast, lucky, and strong. That is truly a 
thorny path filled with countless 
trials... No, precisely because it is 
difficult, it has value.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That crown must shine brilliantly for both 
the runners and the onlookers alike.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, a Triple Crown Umamusume is an 
unmatched status— one upon which hope and 
trust are placed.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...Status. That is, in order to obtain 
it—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, that is one of the complex 
elements that constitute the Triple Crown 
route, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And this is merely my own personal view. 
If you were to ask another 
Umamusume—especially her—...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Aren't you overthinking things?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I mean... hey, Ms. Reporter. Why do you 
think that bird is flying?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...? Since it's circling, could it be 
searching for food... perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're overthinking it again. The 
answer can be much simpler, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's flying because it's a bird that can 
fly. Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm an Umamusume who can run, I just 
run. Wherever my heart takes me. Wherever 
the wind blows.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
When you find a path that looks fun, you 
enjoy it to the fullest. No matter what 
might be waiting for you there, right?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, in her case, that order might 
actually be reversed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...The Triple Crown route is a stage 
where the strongest gather. Then there is 
no choice other than to challenge it."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: No matter how strong an opponent awaits?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's *because* they're waiting for 
us. And every last one of them is staking 
everything on their one shot.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And only after sharpening your skills 
through fierce competition... can you 
finally earn the title of 'The Strongest.'

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
! A title... If I recall, Symboli 
Rudolf-san mentioned that being a Triple 
Crown Umamusume is a 'status.' As 
expected, the Triple Crown is an 
unparalleled pinnacle—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No. This is the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
An admission ticket to the hunting grounds 
where those hailed as the "strongest"—with 
power they have yet to fully 
unleash—gather.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"If we're going to challenge them anyway, 
there's no point unless they recognize us 
as opponents they truly have to crush... 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I must earn the same title and stand 
alongside her ...to truly taste the full 
bite of her fangs.

text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Pages
text_block_list.text:
"Though what each pursues may differ, the 
words 'Triple Crown Umamusume' possess a 
mysterious... and undeniable charm."

text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Pages
text_block_list.text:
"And so, the Umamusume follow that path. 
Past, present—and the Triple Crown 
Umamusume of the future." 
Interviewer/Editor: Etsuko Otonashi
